chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ibn Bukayr, from Qudama ibn Zaida, who said:
I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) placed his son Ibrahim with a gentle placing, and squared his grave.

key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمُ: Ibrahim, the son of the Prophet
key_terms.رَبَّعَ: To square or make rectangular (specifically regarding the grave's shape)
key_terms.سَلَّ: To place or lay down gently

ai.seo_question: What was the Prophet's method for placing his son Ibrahim in the grave?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* establishes the Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) in burying his son Ibrahim, emphasizing both the gentle lowering of the body and the specific architectural practice of 'squaring' the grave (making it rectangular). In Shia jurisprudence, this serves as a primary textual basis for the recommended method of grave construction, distinguishing it from simple pit burial and highlighting the dignity accorded to the deceased.
